name: Palo Alto Networks Certified Next-Generation Firewall Engineer

third_party_evaluations.summary: PCNSE successor validating NGFW deployment, Panorama, identity, SSL decryption, and automation at scale.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Deployment, management, decryption and automation at scale support professional network-defense delivery at three years; the recorded successor status does not itself establish expert cross-vendor scope.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded scaled deployment, Panorama, identity, decryption and automation with three years of experience support professional firewall engineering. Vendor concentration and no explicit lab limit expert implementation assurance.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded large-scale firewall deployment, identity, decryption and automation scope supports professional engineering decisions at three years. I do not infer expert hands-on assessment from the proctored format alone.
